meta.policy: Only published, source-attributed numbers are computed. Every unverified component is left null so it renders blank, never estimated. The ladder shows 'documented published fees', not an all-in quote.

assumptions.text: Reference exchange rate: 7.129 CNY per USD, the IRS 2025 yearly average for China (S05). Labelled reference conversion only; not an executable rate.
Tiers are U.S. dollar amounts sent, from USD 10,000 to USD 400,000 in USD 10,000 steps (40 tiers). The CNY amount is derived as USD x 7.129.
R01 uses the HSBC Premier / Advance published percentage: 0.1% of the remittance amount, minimum CNY 100, maximum CNY 500 per transaction, plus a CNY 120 cable charge (S24 items 2.2.4.1 and 2.2.4.2).
R02 uses the published Global Transfer to Self fee: Free for Private Banking and Premier, USD 20 per transaction for Advance (S24 item 2.2.6.1).
R07 uses the published over-the-counter foreign-currency note withdrawal fee of Free (S24 item 2.2.2.1) and the USD 10,000 per person per exit cash cap (S14).

NOT included anywhere in the computed figures: FX spread, correspondent/intermediary bank charges, receiving bank charges, optional 'Pay Exact' (CNY 200), taxes, penalties, professional fees, and travel costs.

No assumption is made about the user's HSBC segment, residency, PRC household registration, source of funds or U.S. filing history. Where a fee depends on the segment, both published variants are shown.
